sources.entry: PushMate - Solves common push notification problems on macOS.

summary.name: PushMate
summary.one_liner: PushMate is a Mac app for editing and validating Apple Push Notification Service (APNS) JSON payloads.
keywords: edit push notification json on mac
use_cases: Editing APNS notification payloads on a Mac
Checking push payloads against Apple's format rules before sending
Catching JSON errors while typing a notification payload
Debugging push notification problems on macOS
summary.what_it_does: PushMate is a macOS editor for Apple Push Notification Service JSON payloads. It validates a notification payload against Apple's payload format rules and highlights issues as you type. It offers completion for payload keys to help write the JSON. The page says it supports Dark Mode, Mojave, and modern Mac features such as autosave and versioning.
notable: Live error checking that highlights payload issues as you type
Mac native with autosave and versioning, and Dark Mode support
caveats: Pricing and licensing are not stated on the page
Only macOS is named as a platform
